latest_final:
The opening is a wordplay trap. "Courses" and the "deadline" do not refer to academic modules and course registration at all; they refer to the dishes (courses of a meal) that the student had to choose in advance for a university hall/high-table dinner. She is a student at HKU and did make her menu choices by the dinner deadline, but the puzzle is about the meal, not her degree.

At the formal hall dinner, the dishes she had chosen were served to her, but she managed only to taste a small portion of each one. Her plates were then cleared by the waiting staff before she had finished, and the unfinished food was taken away and thrown out rather than kept for her. Because the dishes had been removed and discarded, by the end of the evening all the courses she had chosen were "gone," leaving her without a full dinner even though nothing supernatural or academic had happened.
